description: China's headline National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) macro indicators — one tool, pick an `indicator`: `cpi` (Consumer Price Index, national/urban/rural, y/y + m/m), `ppi` (Producer Price Index), `pmi` (manufacturing + non-manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index), `gdp` (quarterly GDP, published as year-to-date cumulative, by sector), `industrial_production` (industrial value-added growth), `retail_sales` (total retail sales of consumer goods), `fixed_asset_investment` (FAI), `money_supply` (M0/M1/M2 outstanding + growth), or `trade` (General Administration of Customs monthly export/import totals in USD). Returns the latest period's values first (with its period, e.g. "2026-09"), then up to `periods` months/quarters of history, newest first — every Chinese NBS field name translated to an English name with its unit and the index convention it uses (prior-period = 100 unless stated otherwise). Answers "China's latest CPI", "China PMI history", "China Q2 GDP growth", "China M2 money supply", "China's trade surplus last month". Keyless, sourced live from the National Bureau of Statistics of China (General Administration of Customs for `trade`), via Eastmoney's data centre.

periods.description: How many of the most recent monthly/quarterly rows to return, 1-36 (default 12).
